title: StackChoiceOrderRequest
description: STACK-MODELS-PAGE-01. The body of `PUT /stack/v1/choices/{category}/order`: candidate ids tried first to last, and optionally the switched-off list.

order.description: Candidate ids, tried first to last. Candidates left out keep their default place after these.

off.description: The candidates switched off. Omitted leaves the off list as it is.
